_meta.purpose: Atomic process/wizard blocks. A process is a SEQUENCE of static step frames; the recurring units are a PROGRESS indicator (stepper or ProgressBar), a STEP HEADER (title + description), STEP CONTENT (reused FORM fieldsets/fields), a STEP NAV row (Back/Next), a SUMMARY ROW (label + value + Ändern) for a review step, and a CONFIRMATION block for the final frame. process/block-patterns.json composes these into a step body and a confirmation screen.
_meta.vocabulary: Content-element names follow layout-guidelines.md → Contentarten: Headline/Title (step title), Meta/caption ('Schritt X von Y', step labels), Label + value (summary rows). Use these terms.
_meta.spacingModel: A process inherits R from its PRODUCT — same rule as a form (content/website → R = lg, application/dashboard → R = md, dense data app → R = sm). LADDER (R-relative): (1) elements in a block; card padding = R; (2) grouped bits — step-header title↔description, summary label↔value, stepper marker↔label, progress caption↔bar = R−1; (3) a header/title-block → its content region = R+1; (4) progress / step / nav blocks to each other, and the section header → content = R+2. RESOLUTION (token per role × product R): content/website (R lg) → R lg, R−1 md, R+1 xl, R+2 2xl; application/dashboard (R md) → R md, R−1 sm, R+1 lg, R+2 xl; dense app (R sm) → R sm, R−1 xs, R+1 md, R+2 lg. The fragments below are written at the R = md REFERENCE; substitute every gap by its role when the product's R differs.
_meta.colorModel: emphasis-100 (color.text.strong) for the step title AND the ACTIVE step's label/summary values; color.text.muted for captions, done/upcoming step labels, and summary labels. Stepper marker state via Badge semantic: done = Successful, active = Informational (or brand), upcoming = Neutral. Confirmation success icon binds color.icon + semantic Successful.
_meta.componentNote: NO Stepper component exists in the DB UX Stable/Beta set — process.stepper is a guideline-authored COMPOSITION from resolved components (Badge markers + Body labels). It is TEMPORARY: replace with a real Stepper once it ships. The ProgressBar is a Concept component (requires Concept opt-in); its Value stops are 25/50/75% samples — pick the nearest to Schritt/steps and phrase the caption to match. Field blocks in a step are REUSED from form/blocks.json (label-above, applyProps { Show Label:true, Label, Show Required Asterisk }, fillWidth).
_meta.authoringRule: Components (`type`/`props`) MUST resolve in components.json and tokens in tokens.json — structure/spacing come from the guidelines; components/tokens are never invented. A composed block (stepper) is allowed when no component covers the need, as long as its parts resolve against the live registries.
_meta.placeholderConvention: <...> = fill with real content; optional trailing '?' means the node may be dropped when empty. A '<a|b|c>' placeholder is a closed choice.
_meta.refConvention: { "$ref": "block.id" } expands to that block's `plan` fragment. Form field blocks are expanded from form/blocks.json. The agent expands $ref when authoring the plan — the runtime never sees $ref.

process.step-marker.purpose: One item in the composed stepper: a Badge marker + a short label, vertically centered (marker↔label grouped at R−1 = sm). The marker encodes the step STATE with THREE plans: (a) DONE (planDone) = Badge content:'icon' (Size Small) with a CHECK icon (applyProps { 'Icon Small': 'check' }) + semantic 'Successful' — a green check, no number — and a muted label, full opacity; (b) ACTIVE (planActive) = Badge content:'text' Size Medium with the step number in the DEFAULT ADAPTIVE semantic (an outlined dark circle — NOT Informational/blue) + a strong bold label, full opacity; (c) UPCOMING (planUpcoming) = the SAME adaptive Size-Medium number badge + label, but the WHOLE marker is DISABLED via opacity: 0.4. SIZE MATCHING: an icon Badge at Size Small ≈ a text Badge at Size Medium, so the DONE check stays Small while the ACTIVE/UPCOMING number badges use Size Medium and all markers line up. DISABLED = opacity 0.4 on the marker container (dims badge + label together); do not muted-dim on top of it (opacity carries the disabled look).

process.stepper.purpose: The composed step indicator: a full-width spread row of step markers, evenly distributed. Earlier steps DONE (green check badge, Successful); the CURRENT step ACTIVE (adaptive outlined number badge + strong bold label, full opacity); later steps UPCOMING (same adaptive number badge + label, whole marker DISABLED at opacity 0.4). NO Stepper component exists — this is a temporary composition of Badge + Body. Connector lines are omitted (no robust connector primitive); spacing conveys the sequence.

process.progress.purpose: The lighter/linear progress alternative: a 'Schritt X von Y' caption above a ProgressBar (Concept). Caption↔bar grouped at R−1 (sm). Pick the bar's Value stop (25/50/75%) nearest the step fraction and match the caption.

process.step-header.purpose: The current step's title + optional one-line description. Title is the frame's h1; title↔description grouped at R−1 (sm).

process.step-nav.purpose: The step-navigation row: a secondary 'Zurück' (ghost, left) and a primary 'Weiter' (Brand, right), spread to the column edges. Drop 'Zurück' on the first step (then a single right-aligned 'Weiter'). The last input step's primary is the commit action (e.g. 'Zahlungspflichtig buchen'). ≤1 Brand per frame.

process.summary-row.purpose: One reviewed value in a review step: a label + its entered value on the left, an 'Ändern' Link on the right, spread across the width. Label↔value is a tight stacked pair (2xs); rows are separated by Dividers in the summary block.

process.confirmation.purpose: The final success frame content: a centered Successful-tinted icon, a Heading, a short confirmation text (booking ref etc.), and a single primary action. No stepper/nav. Centered column.
